### Bible Pathway - August 16
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-16-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 7:23
Points:
- People constantly pursue worldly status and personal desires yet end up unfulfilled.
- God reveals in Scripture that genuine happiness and lasting success come through obedience.
- Obedience to God is not a sign of weakness or oppressive bondage, but surrendering to His good will.
- Trusting and walking in the Lord's ways frees believers from anxiety and leads to abundant life.
